Definition: a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (i.e. mishap)
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉphîyrâh is the word for a crown. In Isaiah 28:5, In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and it appears again in Ezekiel 7:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a crown can be glory in Isaiah and doom in Ezekiel, and the difference is whose head wears it.
